 Follow Daylight Savings Ends on Earliest Possible Date This Year: That Means More Time for Halloween
 OregonLive.com Thu, October 22, 2026 at 5:10 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Daylight saving time ends Nov. 1, the earliest possible date, with clocks moving back an hour at 2 a.m. The change comes just after Halloween on Oct. 31, meaning party-goers could get an extra hour of festivities that night. The return to standard time shifts more daylight into the morning and away from the evening. Congress failed to stop this year's switch. Daylight saving time resumes Sunday, March 14, 2027, when clocks move forward one hour under the current time-change schedule.
